RIVATE MEMBERS’ MOTIONS 
 
The Assembly resumed the adjourned debate on the proposed Motion No. 2, moved by Mr. Belanger: 
 
That this Assembly call upon the government to fulfill the calls to action in the Truth and 
Reconciliation Commission’s final report that pertain to the jurisdiction of the provincial government.
